observations.behavior: Adds a loading state to the unsnooze button and its accessibility attributes.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to see that clearing an alert snooze is in progress; this could prevent duplicate clicks or confusion while waiting for the API response.

observations.behavior: Renders Snooze and Clear Snooze buttons only when not already snoozed. Splits the UI into two mutually exclusive states: one with Snooze, another with Unsnooze.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies available actions based on current alert status, reducing user error by hiding irrelevant controls.

observations.behavior: Displays a clock icon alongside text indicating snooze expiry or generic 'Snoozed' label depending on whether an end time exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides immediate visual context about the snooze duration without requiring inspection of backend data, aiding usability.

observations.limitations: Changes are confined to frontend presentation and form behavior; no changes were made to backend ingestion, database storage, query execution, warehouse connectors, identity replication, shared security middleware, or migration helpers.

review.limitations: Changes are confined to frontend presentation and form behavior; no changes were made to backend ingestion, database storage, query execution, warehouse connectors, identity replication, shared security middleware, or migration helpers.
review.reason: Adds bounded capability and reliability improvement: explicit loading state and clearer action visibility during unsnooze operations. This demonstrates implementation and relevant checks but does not reach systemic risk reduction across components.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant for PostHog users who manage alerts, particularly those relying on temporary suppression while debugging or awaiting fixes. The change could reduce support requests related to accidental double-clicks or unclear button availability.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on this chunk; broader adoption or incident avoidance cannot be established from this isolated frontend-only modification.
